source: Read-only installed torch_npu 2.10 Python sources; no framework import or NPU call during audit

reset_peak_memory_stats.meaning: Resets peak counters tracked by the NPU allocator for the selected device

memory_stats.meaning: Returns per-device allocator counters; allocated_bytes.all.peak is allocated tensor-byte peak

max_memory_allocated.missing_key_policy: A missing counter is unknown, not a measured zero

limits: Allocator peak is not whole-card HBM usage or container host memory
Device seconds are conservative synchronized call-window wall time, not summed kernel execution time
Controller timeouts, host RAM limits and NPU process gates remain separate hard controls
